decision: Removing per-token route assignment does not explain the retention miss and is not authorized for implementation. Both contemporaneous paths run materially below the historical 264.15 B/s reference, while v19 is slightly faster than the direct v18-equivalent loop. The V719 cross-run retention ratio is therefore confounded by machine/runtime drift and cannot isolate a v19 regression.
authorized_next_action: One full-depth, interleaved, paired, same-harness comparison of the signed v18 and v19 packages on 100 distinct ordinary prompts plus 20 repeats. Preserve the 95% retention threshold and exact output gate. No implementation change or runtime optimization is authorized first.
claim_boundary: Read-only negative attribution plus evidence of cross-run drift; no corrected retention result, runtime promotion, stable frontier, Phase 4, or superiority claim.
